integrity: Proof is analytical. Finite LP computations independently corroborate samples and are not used as a universal proof.
scientific_limitations: Requires at least three coordinates and a positive link with twice the link no larger than the smallest coordinate length; no claim about fixed-sum sections or outside the link regime. Historical priority is provisional; no independent mathematical audit.
title: Cyclic-interval formula and order-sensitive Minkowski asymmetry of chainlink polytopes
